0022600145.text: Both teams are 0-4 and on four-game losing streaks, with the Pelicans hosting from 14th in the West and the Kings sitting 15th. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and New Orleans won the 2025-26 series 2-1, though its most recent meeting was a 117-113 loss in Sacramento on April 3, 2026. New Orleans will be without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee).
